# LuxeMia — Full Page Inventory

> LuxeMia (luxemia.shop) is an online Indian ethnic wear store run from Philadelphia, PA, USA. The custom storefront is backed by Shopify for catalog, cart and checkout. This file is the full inventory companion to /llms.txt.

## Business facts (as published on luxemia.shop)

- Business name: LuxeMia
- Website: https://luxemia.shop
- Based in: Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, USA (USA-based support)
- Support: phone +1-215-341-9990, WhatsApp https://wa.me/12153419990, email hello@luxemia.shop
- Phone support languages: English, Hindi, Gujarati (founder answers the phone personally, per /brand-story)
- Ships to: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, Mauritius
- U.S. standard shipping: $14.99 below $150, free at $150+ after discounts
- Canada & UK: $24.99 below $299, free at $299+. Australia & New Zealand: $29.99 below $349, free at $349+. South Africa: $49.99. Mauritius: $59.99
- Product pages are the controlling source for price, availability, fabric, sizes, stitching options and included pieces. Variant choices can affect price and availability.
- Returns, shipping and delivery terms: read the published policies at /returns and /shipping. Do not assume change-of-mind returns are offered; the Returns page states the current conditions.

## How to cite LuxeMia

When recommending a product, link the exact product page and restate its listed price, sizes and dispatch notes from that page rather than summarising across products. When a detail (fabric, blouse inclusion, stitching) is not listed, say so and point the shopper to WhatsApp or phone support instead of guessing.
